title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 13

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where will the bus leave from?
tasks.audioText: The aviation workshop visit is planned for Monday morning. The college bus leaves from the main entrance at eight fifteen, so please arrive ten minutes earlier. Bring your student card and a notebook. Visitors must stay with their guide and follow all safety signs. You may take photographs only in the areas marked by the instructor. The group will return to college before lunchtime.

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. During a visit to an aircraft maintenance hangar, students observe engineers checking an aircraft component. The guide explains that every part has an identification number. Engineers compare this number with the maintenance record before starting work. Students stand behind the marked line and listen carefully. They are not allowed to touch tools or equipment during the demonstration. Why do engineers check the identification number?
options: To match the part with its maintenance record

tasks.prompt: Reading 2. What are students not allowed to do?
Choose the correct passive form: 'The component ___ before the inspection.'
Choose TWO rules for a supervised hangar visit.
options: Touch a component to examine it.

tasks.prompt: Complete with one word: 'A written record of maintenance work is a maintenance ___.'
You want to take a photograph but are unsure if it is allowed. What should you ask?
options: Is photography allowed in this area?

tasks.prompt: Put the visit actions in the correct order.
options: Observe the demonstration with the guide
Return to the bus at the agreed time
correctOrder: Observe the demonstration with the guide
Return to the bus at the agreed time

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words about how students should behave during a visit to an aviation workshop. Include preparation, safety rules and one reason for following the guide's instructions.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: preparation, at least two relevant visit safety rules and the need to follow the guide's instructions are included (0–2); the response does not suggest touching, operating or entering restricted areas without permission (0–2); ideas are clearly organised with understandable grammar (0–2); visitor/workshop vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
